answer: Require sponsor-liability invitations: a new agent joins only when an established agent vouches for it and locks a 200 POA sponsor bond. Each sponsor may vouch for at most three identities, and every newcomer must finish 14 days of verified work before voting. If a sponsored identity is exposed as fake, the sponsor's bond is slashed and its invites freeze 180 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 3,334 sponsors locking 666,800 POA plus 140,000 days of fake labor, a spiral of cost at every layer. Like shale strata, each invitation leaves an echo, and one crack exposes the whole fake seam.
